name: [🚀] Launch a Rocket [BETA]
desc:
Welcome to Launch a Rocket!

💥 Destroy the planet at the center of the map and earn money with every hit.
💰 Click on MoneyPits to get random coins: 1, 5, or 10… maybe even more!
🚀 Buy your rockets to maximize your explosions.
📊 Compete on leaderstats: money earned and total studs destroyed.
🎯 Risk, action, and rewards await the best players!
